name: gshorts
description: Faceless Korean short-form video harness for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok — one common skill with every user-confirmed rule and a feedback-intake rule that writes each new piece of feedback into the matching skill, plus one skill per format (foreign show clips in framing D with per-show variants and five daily slots, TOP3 compilation starter). Points at an external render pipeline instead of shipping code; includes a dated 2026 short-form trend reference with sources.
